tasks.desc: Pick a cached protocol (protocols.io corpus or tier-1 BioProt) and ground it step by step in the browser: each step shows the rules verdict with quantities, entities and skill, plus LLM-fallback alternatives for unresolved steps. Approve, reject or edit each step; decisions save to runs/<run_id>/grounding.json with rules/LLM/human provenance for later text-pair export. Stdlib-only, extends lab2rob/review/app.py. Done: ground one protocol in the app, accept/edit one step, decision on disk; route tests green.
tasks.title: Pipeline GUI: per-step grounding review

tasks.desc: From approved grounded steps: program ops preview per step (skill sequence, bound args, recorded assumptions, out-of-scope categories), independent judge predicates plus outcome checks, then a build and certify trigger (execute, predicate check, visual check, one repair) with progress, ending in the run accept/reject panels. Reuses the SC-06 run detail views. Done: one protocol walked end to end in the browser to a certified run decision; tests green.
tasks.title: Pipeline GUI: specify, certify and run review
